instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Biotech company developing novel monoclonal antibody therapies for autoimmune diseases. Lead candidate in Phase II clinical trials for rheumatoid arthritis with promising biomarker data. 65-person R&D team. Key innovation need is AI-accelerated candidate screening using in-silico protein folding and binding affinity prediction. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.

Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

input.changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

opportunities.title: Digital Self-Service and Customer Experience Overhaul
opportunities.rationale: Customer churn is accelerating due to perceived stagnation and poor digital self-service tools. This opportunity moves beyond basic fixes to rebuild the customer journey, acting as a critical market defense measure against competitor encroachment.

first_actions: Conduct immediate gap analysis comparing current state functionality against industry best practices for biotech client portals (focusing on compliance and data security).
Prioritize 'Minimum Viable Customer Portal' features that solve the top 3 cited pain points from exit interviews (e.g., documentation access, service tracking).
Engage legal/compliance counsel to ensure all new customer-facing digital tools meet stringent regulatory standards for PHI and data handling.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce quarterly mid-tier/enterprise customer churn rate by 10% within 12 months.
milestones: CX Pain Point Mapping Complete (3 Months)
Alpha Portal Release for Internal Testing (6 Months)

opportunities.title: AI-Accelerated Candidate Discovery Platform Implementation
opportunities.rationale: To combat stagnation and maintain innovation leadership in a competitive environment, the company must transition from internal hypothesis testing to a scalable, AI-driven discovery process. This requires a significant leap into advanced computation and specialized talent.

first_actions: Commission an external feasibility study evaluating vendor platforms for in-silico protein folding and binding affinity prediction.
Identify key internal 'champions' (R&D scientists) who can drive the conceptualization and input data structure required for the AI models.
Develop a proof-of-concept workflow to integrate existing research databases with potential external AI endpoints.
Conduct GDPR and data privacy compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Successfully generate a novel candidate profile or hypothesis using AI tools, validated by experimental data, within 18 months.

next_steps.action: Execute a deep dive into customer journey maps focusing on the digital touchpoints for mid-tier and enterprise accounts to quantify process failures.
Formalize a cross-functional 'Innovation Steering Committee' including Marketing, R&D, and Strategy leadership to break down departmental silos.
Initiate a structured search for AI/ML expertise, considering consulting partnerships or targeted talent acquisition to drive the discovery platform.

key_weaknesses: High dependency on specific internal advocates rather than formalized, scalable processes for innovation.
Ad-hoc system integration across critical operational areas creates significant risk and limits scalability.
The 'small leadership team' structure acts as a bottleneck, hindering rapid strategic scaling required to compete with major market entrants.

improvements: IoT rollout has achieved success in predicting equipment failure, de-risking maintenance operations and providing initial cost savings.
The company successfully articulated the urgent need for customer experience modernization based on tangible churn data (92% to 84%).
persistent_gaps: Lack of robust digital integration between primary systems hinders both R&D efficiency and customer self-service capabilities.
The strategy remains reactive (market defense) rather than proactively setting a differentiated market standard.
achieved_milestones: Business case approved for full IoT fleet rollout, de-risking the next phase of operational expenditure planning.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The external environment has significantly deteriorated due to major competitor entry and increased customer churn risk. While internal progress on IoT is positive, the immediate strategic focus must pivot from operational improvement to market defense via digital CX overhaul and radical technological advancement (AI).
